title: Exotic Herby Croatian Lamb Skewers
description: Fresh and flavorful lamb skewers featuring basil leaves, perfect for a meal prep Croatian dish, cooked to perfection on a tava griddle, garlic and onion free.
instructions: Preheat the tava griddle to medium high heat, around 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped basil leaves to the bowl and mix well.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb pieces onto the wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the preheated tava griddle and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Use a bain marie to keep the skewers warm while they are cooking.
Once the lamb is cooked through, remove the skewers from the heat and let them rest for a few minutes.
Serve the lamb skewers hot, garnished with additional basil leaves if desired.
